run_grpc_client_scenario: run a gRPC client scenario like unary unary or stream stream on a given channel
create_Pipe_iterator: create a thread-safe Pipe iterator that blocks until values are added or closed
run_unary_unary_call: run a unary unary gRPC call and compare the response to the expected outcome
run_stream_stream_call: run a bidirectional stream gRPC call by sending requests and verifying paired responses
run_concurrent_stream_unary: run multiple concurrent stream unary gRPC calls and verify all return satisfactory outcomes
